title: Multi-Tier API Quotas & Tenant Throttling
learningObjectives: Design multi-tier quota limits (Free vs Pro vs Enterprise) per API key
Implement fair-share tenant resource throttling to prevent noisy-neighbor degradation
Track monthly rollover usage and send usage warning notifications
keyTradeoffs: Hard cut-off on quota exhaustion vs billing for overages with soft throttling
Evaluating usage in API gateway middleware vs asynchronous billing aggregation
commonPitfalls: A single free-tier customer consuming 100% of available backend database connections
Timezone mismatch bugs when resetting monthly quota allowances
transferPrompt: How do you design API responses and error codes when a customer exceeds their paid tier quota?
